mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_conversation_turn_event (tenant_id, conversation_id, turn_id, dispatch_attempt, event_seq, chunk_index, chunk_count, event_type, payload_fragment) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{dispatchAttempt}, #{eventSeq}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkCount}, #{eventType}, #{payloadFragment})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_conversation_turn_event WHERE gmt_create < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_conversation c WHERE c.id = agent_conversation_turn_event.conversation_id AND c.tenant_id = agent_conversation_turn_event.tenant_id AND c.channel = 'PLATFORM_ASSISTANT') LIMIT #{limit}
